spans.s: At home, in the house; कामश्चरताममाभूत्
With, near, close to; अमैवासां तद्भवति Bṛi.
Together with, in conjunction or company with, as in अमात्य, अमावास्या q. v.; अमाकृ to draw near, have near oneself. अमा सह समीपे च Nm. -f.
The day of the new moon, the day of the conjunction of the sun and moon; अमायां तु सदा सोम ओषधीः प्रतिपद्यते Vyāsa.
The sixteenth digit of the moon.

The fifteenth digit also.m. The soul. -Comp. -अक्त a. Ved. met, come together. -अन्तः The end of the day of new moon.-इष्ट a. Sacrificed at home. -जुर् f. Living at home during life, growing old at home; अमाजुरश्चिद्भवयो युवं भगो
; being without husband in the same dwelling with her parents, as a maiden (पितृषद्); अमाजूरिव पित्रोः सचा सती
. -पर्वन् n. The sacred time of अमा, day of new moon. -हठः Name of a snake-demon; Mb.

Raw, uncooked, undressed (opp. पक्व) (oft. applied to the cow in the Veda;
Unripe, immature; तुदन्त्या- मत्वचं दंशा मशका मत्कुणादयः

Indigestion; आहारस्य रसः सारः यो न पक्वो$ग्निलाघवात् । आमसंज्ञां स लभते महाव्याधिसमाश्रयः ॥ Suśr. -Comp. -अतिसारः dysentery or diarrhœa caused by vitiated mucus in the abdomen (the excretion being in this case mixed with hard and fetid matter). आमातिसारे नो कार्य- मादौ संग्रहणं नृणाम् Suśr. -अद् a. eating raw flesh or food; आमादः क्ष्विङ्कास्त मदन्त्वेनीः
. -अन्नम् undressed rice. -आशयः [आमस्यापक्वान्नस्याशयः] 'receptacle of undigested food', the upper part of the belly to the navel, stomach. -कुम्भः a jar of unbaked clay;
. -गन्धि n. smelling of raw meat of a burning corpse. -गन्धिकम् the smell of raw meat. -ज्वरः a kind of fever; cf. स्वेद्यमामज्वरं प्राज्ञः को$म्भसा परिषिञ्चति Śi.2.54. -त्वच् a. of tender skin.

A method of mellowing or ripening a tumour; Suśr.. -पात्रम् an unannealed vessel;

. -पीनसम् running at the nose, defluxion. -पेशाः Grains pounded in a raw condition.-मांसाशिन् m. a cannibal, an eater of raw flesh. -रक्तम् dysentery. -रसः imperfect chyme. -वातः constipation, torpor of the bowels attended with flatulence and intumescence. -शूलः pain of indigestion, colic. -श्राद्धम् a Śrāddha performed with uncooked food; आपद्यनग्नौ तीर्थे च चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे तथा । आमश्राद्धं द्विजैः कार्यं शूद्रेण च सदैव हि ॥ Prāchetasa.
आम [āma] मा [mā] नस्यम् [nasyam], (मा) नस्यम् [अमनस्-ष्यञ्] Pain, sorrow.
; अमङ्गल्यं शीलं तव भवतु नामैकमखिलम् Puṣpadanta.
Unlucky, unfortune. -लः The castor-oil tree (एरण्ड). -लम् Inauspiciousness, ill-luck; evil; oft. used in dramatic literature; शान्तं पापं प्रतिहतम- मङ्गलम्; cf. God forbid.
Without froth or scum (as boiled rice). -ण्डः The castor oil tree (एरण्ड) Ricinus communis.
Not felt, not perceptible by the mind, unknown.
Disliked, not agreed to, see under अम् also. -Comp. -परार्थता 'an unaccepted second sense', one of the faults of a word (शब्ददोष); अमतः प्रकृतविरुद्धः परार्थो यत्र; e. g. in राममन्मथशरेण ताडिता &c. (
) the second sense suggestive of शृङ्गाररस is opposed to the proper rasa of the passage which is either वीर or बीभत्स; K.
अमति [amati], a. Evil-minded, wicked, depraved. -तिः A rogue, cheat. -तिः f.
Ignorance, unconsciousness, absence of knowledge, intention, or fore-thought; अमत्यैतानि षड् जग्ध्वा
;4.222. For some of the other senses see under अम्. -Comp. -पूर्व a. unconscious, unintentional.

.] Overpowering (enemies), strong or disposed to march on (गमन- शील); स्वरिरमत्रो ववक्षे रणाय
A pot, vessel, utensil. उत्तार्य गोपी सुशृतं पयः पुनः प्रविश्य संदृश्य च दध्यमत्रकम्
Boundless, immeasurable; अमात्रं त्वा धिषणा तित्विषे
Having the measure or quantity of the letter अ.
Not a measure or quantity. -त्रः The Supreme Spirit.
अमत्सर [amatsara], a. Unenvious, disinterested; यद्यद्रोचेत विप्रेभ्य- स्तत्तद्दद्यादमत्सरः
अमदनः [amadanḥ], Name of Śiva. Bhaviṣya P.
अमधव्य [amadhavya], a. Not sweet, not worthy of the sweetness of Soma.
Without the organ of desire, thought &c.
Having no control over the mind.
Not the organ of desire, non-perception.

Inattention.m. The Supreme Being. -Comp. -गत a. Unknown, unthought of. -नीत, -ज्ञ a. Disapproved, condemned; reprobate. -योगः Absence of concentration of mind, inattention. -हर a. displeasing, disagreeable.

violently bit. -न्दः N. of a tree.

Not being aware of; अमन्यमानाञ्छर्वा जघान
अमन्युत [amanyuta], a. Ved. Not bearing ill-will towards another; अमन्युता नो वीरुधो भवन्तु
अमम [amama], a. Without egotism, without any selfish or worldly attachment, devoid of personal ties or desires; शरणेष्वममश्चैव वृक्षमूलनिकेतनः
-मः The twelfth Jaina saint of a future उत्सर्पिणी.
अमाम [amāma] मा [mā] सी [sī], (मा) सी = अमावसी or अमावस्या q. v.
अमर [amara], a. [मृ-पचाद्यच् न. त.] Undying, immortal, imperishable; अजरामरवत् प्राज्ञो विद्यामर्थं च चिन्तयेत् H.
N. of a plant Euphorbia Tirucalli (स्नुहीवृक्ष; Mar. शेर). Tiaridium Indicum (हस्तिशुण्ड ?; Mar. भुरुंडी).
The number 33. (that being the number of Gods.)
N. of Amarasiṁha, see below; of a mountain.
Mystical signification of the syllable उ.
रा The residence of Indra (cf. अमरावती).

N. of several plants; इन्द्रवारुणी, वटी, महानीली, घृतकुमारी, स्नुही, गुडूची, दूर्वा. -री The same as अमरा. -Comp. -अङ्गना, -स्त्री a celestial nymph, heavenly damsel; मुषाण रत्नानि हरामराङ्गनाः Śi.1. 51. -अद्रिः 'mountain of the gods'; हृतामराद्रिस्थानेन ज्ञापितो भौमचेष्टितम्
. N. of the mountain Sumeru.-अधिपः, -इन्द्रः, -ईशः, -ईश्वरः, -पतिः, -भर्ता, -राजः &c. 'The lord of the gods', epithets of Indra; प्रेमदत्तवदना- निलः पिवन्नत्यजीवदमरालकेश्वरौ

The planet Jupiter. -चन्द्रः Name of the author of Bālabhārata. -(रं)जयः Conquering the gods. Bhaviṣya P. -जः N. of a tree, a kind of खदिर.
तरुः, दारु a celestial tree, a tree in the paradise of Indra; अमरतरुकुसुमसौरभसेवनसंपूर्णसकलकामस्य
the wish-yielding tree. -दत्तः Name of a lexicographer, of a prince. Ks. -द्विजः a Brāhmaṇa who lives by attending a temple or idol; or one who superintends a temple.
पुरम् the residence of the gods, celestial paradise.
पुष्पः, ष्पकः N. of several plants (केतक, चूत).

the wish-yielding tree (कल्पवृक्ष). -पुष्पिका N. of a plant (अधःपुष्पीवृक्ष); a kind of anise. -प्रख्य, -प्रभ a. like an immortal. -प्रभुः one of the 1 names of Viṣṇu.-माला N. of a lexicon. (said to be composed by the same author as that of Amarakośa.) -रत्नम a crystal.-राजः N. of Indra. -लोकः the world of the gods, heaven; ˚ता heavenly bliss; तेषु सम्यग्वर्तमानो गच्छत्यमरलोकताम्

. -Comp. -जात a. not produced in a vital organ. -वेधिन् a. not injuring the vital parts; mild, soft. -वेधिता f. The state of not inflicting severe injury on others, absence of acrimony (one of the thirtyfive Vāg-guṇas of a Tīrthaṅkara).
Exceeding due limits or bounds, transgressing every bound, disrespectful, improper; मर्यादायाममर्यादाः स्त्रियस्तिष्ठन्ति सर्वदा
; तादृशं त्वममर्यादं कर्म कर्तुं चिकीर्षसि Rām.
Boundless, infinite. -दा Transgression of due limits or bounds, impropriety of conduct, forwardness, disrespect, violation of due respect.
अमर्ष [amarṣa], a. Not enduring or bearing.

; jealousy, jealous anger; किं नु भवतस्तातप्रतापोत्कर्षे$प्यमर्षः

. -Comp. -ज a. arising from anger or impatience. -हासः an angry laugh, sarcastic sneer.
